title: Proxmox LXC resource and rootfs growth
summary: Reconcile explicit Ansible-owned LXC resources and grow root filesystems without shrinking them.
requirements: Exactly one lifecycle owner for guest memory, swap and rootfs size
Explicit guest hostname lists and matching node/VMID inventory
Verified backup and free storage capacity
verification: Compare pct config against requested memory, swap and rootfs sizes
Verify filesystem capacity and workload health inside each guest
Confirm Terraform does not reconcile the same fields
